name: hush
description: Hide Shorts, Reels, ads, suggestions and other noise on YouTube, X, Reddit, LinkedIn and Instagram. No account, no tracking.

scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.start:chrome: web-ext run -s dist/chrome -t chromium --chromium-binary '/Applications/Brave Browser.app/Contents/MacOS/Brave Browser' --chromium-profile ~/.local/share/hush/chrome-profile --profile-create-if-missing --keep-profile-changes --start-url https://youtube.com
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package:chrome && npm run package:firefox
scripts.package:chrome: web-ext build -s dist/chrome -a web-ext-artifacts/chrome --filename hush-chrome-{version}.zip --ignore-files dev-build.json --overwrite-dest
